backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows. Space variants use exp-20260510-028 augmented Space snapshots and reproduce accepted exp-20260512-013 policy semantics before applying the single low-execution-R/R scalar.
decision_rationale: Execution-adjusted net R/R below the floor did not identify a robust Space risk haircut on top of the accepted exp-20260512-013 stack. It mostly re-weights already sparse low-R/R breakout exposure and does not pass the multi-window EV gate.

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies built from a 2026-05-10 research universe; any accepted change must remain default-off metadata until forward evidence matures.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: haircut official Space signals where exec_lag_adj_net_rr < 2.75.
gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: space_low_exec_rr_risk_scalar; official pool, accepted Space risk scalars, targets, stops, peer-nonleader breakout zero-risk, ranking, add-ons, LLM/news, and live slots stay fixed.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least 2/3 improved EV windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, survival >= 5%, nonzero adjusted signals, and no missing R/R field.
gate_questions.5_reproducibility: This script reruns accepted exp-20260512-013 semantics and each low execution-adjusted R/R scalar across the canonical augmented Space snapshots.

hypothesis: After prior Space target, stop, peer, breadth, 52w proximity, and TQS breakout variants failed or were accepted as fixed context, the next orthogonal Space alpha question is whether production-computed execution-adjusted net R/R separates low-quality official Space signals before sizing.
interpretation: Execution-adjusted net R/R below the floor did not identify a robust Space risk haircut on top of the accepted exp-20260512-013 stack. It mostly re-weights already sparse low-R/R breakout exposure and does not pass the multi-window EV gate.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space event-state forward data remains below the closed-decision gate, so this run avoids LLM soft-ranking and uses deterministic production-computed R/R quality.

next_evidence_needed: Do not retry nearby low execution-adjusted R/R Space scalars on the same frozen snapshots if rejected. Future Space alpha should use forward catalyst replacement value, a genuinely new event-quality field, or a measured candidate-pool expansion.
rejection_reason: Execution-adjusted net R/R below the floor did not identify a robust Space risk haircut on top of the accepted exp-20260512-013 stack. It mostly re-weights already sparse low-R/R breakout exposure and does not pass the multi-window EV gate.
single_causal_variable: risk scalar for official Space signals with execution-adjusted net risk/reward below 2.75
why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking and event-bucket scoring are still sample-limited; peer-nonleader breakout, peer-leader top-up, 52w proximity, basket breadth, mature satcom breadth, one-slot capacity, breakout geometry, data-vendor trend targets, perfect-TQS target broadening, and near-perfect TQS scalar variants already failed or are fixed accepted context.
